diag-tree-head: 051 enum tree_code_class {
diag-tree-head: 052   tcc_exceptional, /* An exceptional code (fits no category).  */
diag-tree-head: 053   tcc_constant,    /* A constant.  */
diag-tree-head: 054   /* Order of tcc_type and tcc_declaration is important.  */

diag-tree-head: 056   tcc_declaration, /* A declaration (also serving as variable refs).  */

diag-tree-head: 060   tcc_binary,      /* A binary arithmetic expression.  */
diag-tree-head: 061   tcc_statement,   /* A statement expression, which have side effects

diag-tree-head: 066 /* Each tree code class has an associated string representation.

diag-tree-head: 080 /* Nonzero if CODE represents an exceptional code.  */
diag-tree-head: 081 
diag-tree-head: 082 #define EXCEPTIONAL_CLASS_P(CODE)\

diag-tree-head: 084 
diag-tree-head: 085 /* Nonzero if CODE represents a constant.  */
diag-tree-head: 086 
diag-tree-head: 087 #define CONSTANT_CLASS_P(CODE)\

diag-tree-head: 089 
diag-tree-head: 090 /* Nonzero if CODE represents a type.  */
diag-tree-head: 091 
diag-tree-head: 092 #define TYPE_P(CODE)\
diag-tree-head: 093 	(TREE_CODE_CLASS (TREE_CODE (CODE)) == tcc_type)
diag-tree-head: 094 
diag-tree-head: 095 /* Nonzero if CODE represents a declaration.  */
diag-tree-head: 096 
diag-tree-head: 097 #define DECL_P(CODE)\
diag-tree-head: 098         (TREE_CODE_CLASS (TREE_CODE (CODE)) == tcc_declaration)
diag-tree-head: 099 
diag-tree-head: 100 /* Nonzero if CODE represents a INDIRECT_REF.  Keep these checks in
diag-tree-head: 101    ascending code order.  */
diag-tree-head: 102 #define INDIRECT_REF_P(CODE)\
diag-tree-head: 103   (TREE_CODE (CODE) == INDIRECT_REF \
diag-tree-head: 104    || TREE_CODE (CODE) == ALIGN_INDIRECT_REF \
diag-tree-head: 105    || TREE_CODE (CODE) == MISALIGNED_INDIRECT_REF)
diag-tree-head: 106 
diag-tree-head: 107 /* Nonzero if CODE represents a reference.  */
diag-tree-head: 108 
diag-tree-head: 109 #define REFERENCE_CLASS_P(CODE)\
diag-tree-head: 110 	(TREE_CODE_CLASS (TREE_CODE (CODE)) == tcc_reference)
diag-tree-head: 111 
diag-tree-head: 112 /* Nonzero if CODE represents a comparison.  */
diag-tree-head: 113 
diag-tree-head: 114 #define COMPARISON_CLASS_P(CODE)\
diag-tree-head: 115 	(TREE_CODE_CLASS (TREE_CODE (CODE)) == tcc_comparison)
diag-tree-head: 116 
diag-tree-head: 117 /* Nonzero if CODE represents a unary arithmetic expression.  */
diag-tree-head: 118 
diag-tree-head: 119 #define UNARY_CLASS_P(CODE)\
diag-tree-head: 120 	(TREE_CODE_CLASS (TREE_CODE (CODE)) == tcc_unary)
diag-tree-head: 121 
diag-tree-head: 122 /* Nonzero if CODE represents a binary arithmetic expression.  */
diag-tree-head: 123 
diag-tree-head: 124 #define BINARY_CLASS_P(CODE)\

diag-tree-head: 126 
diag-tree-head: 127 /* Nonzero if CODE represents a statement expression.  */
diag-tree-head: 128 
diag-tree-head: 129 #define STATEMENT_CLASS_P(CODE)\

diag-tree-head: 131 
diag-tree-head: 132 /* Nonzero if CODE represents any other expression.  */
diag-tree-head: 133 
diag-tree-head: 134 #define EXPRESSION_CLASS_P(CODE)\
diag-tree-head: 135 	(TREE_CODE_CLASS (TREE_CODE (CODE)) == tcc_expression)

diag-tree-head: 137 /* Returns nonzero iff CLASS is not the tree code of a type.  */

diag-builtins-head: 034

diag-builtins-head: 050    `__builtin_' prefix.
